summary: AXIA Energia S.A., the Brazilian electric utility formerly Brazilian Electric Power Co., filed a Form 6-K disclosing Board approval of a second redemption/conversion of its Class C preferred shares (PNC). It will redeem 37,237,014 PNC shares for R$2.0 billion, at R$53.71 per share, representing 6.14% of the outstanding class. The redemption price equals the August 5, 2026 closing price of common shares. Holders may elect to convert PNC into common shares at a 1:1 ratio during August 12–14, 2026, with conversion on August 18, 2026, and redemption payment on August 24, 2026. ADR holders cannot convert; Citibank will distribute proceeds. This mandatory redemption plus optional conversion returns capital to shareholders while potentially reducing preferred overhang.
